title: Let's all meet up in the Y2K
summary: A blog post discussing the organization of a Y2K-themed meetup or gathering, likely celebrating or reflecting on the turn-of-the-millennium era and the cultural/technological phenomena surrounding the year 2000.
problem_solved: Addresses the desire for retro tech enthusiasts to connect and share their experiences from the Y2K era.
why_valuable: Provides a nostalgic gathering point for those interested in late 90s/early 2000s technology culture and the infamous Y2K phenomenon.
